title_vi: Giới từ chỉ thời gian và nơi chốn
theory_html:
A. Exercises in this group

A. Các bài tập trong nhóm

Exercise 173: Put in at, for, during, by, until or in (the history of London).

Bài 173: Điền at, for, during, by, until hoặc in (lịch sử London).

Exercise 174: Answer the questions, beginning each answer with a preposition.

Bài 174: Trả lời câu hỏi, bắt đầu mỗi câu trả lời bằng một giới từ.

Exercise 175: Complete the article with the prepositions from the box (at, by, during, for, in, on, until, while). If no word is necessary, leave the space empty (–).

Bài 175: Hoàn thành bài báo với giới từ trong khung (at, by, during, for, in, on, until, while). Nếu không cần từ nào, để trống (–).

Exercise 176: Choose the correct alternative.

Bài 176: Chọn phương án đúng.

Exercise 177: Put in in, at or on.

Bài 177: Điền in, at hoặc on.

Exercise 178: Choose the correct alternative (Trouble at Norton Mining).

Bài 178: Chọn phương án đúng (Rắc rối ở công ty khai mỏ Norton).

Exercise 179: Complete the answers. Use the words in brackets with one of the prepositions from the box (as, at, by, in, like, on) and any other words you need.

Bài 179: Hoàn thành câu trả lời. Dùng từ trong ngoặc với một giới từ trong khung (as, at, by, in, like, on) và các từ cần thiết khác.

B. Related units

B. Các unit liên quan

English Grammar in Use, Units 117 and 119–128 (theory below).

mcq.question: The city of London was founded by the Romans ___ the year 43 CE.
mcq.full: The city of London was founded by the Romans in the year 43 CE.
mcq.vi: Thành London được người La Mã thành lập vào năm 43 sau Công nguyên.
mcq.expl:
in + year / century; during + a period (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + length of time; until = up to a time; by = not later than; at that time.
in + năm / thế kỷ; during + một khoảng thời gian (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + độ dài thời gian; until = cho đến khi; by = không muộn hơn; at that time.
Điểm ngữ pháp: in + năm.
mcq.key: The city of London was founded by the Romans ___ the year 43 CE.|in

mcq.question: ___ the next few years it quickly became the main trading centre in Britain.
mcq.full: During the next few years it quickly became the main trading centre in Britain.
mcq.vi: Trong vài năm sau đó, nó nhanh chóng trở thành trung tâm thương mại chính của Anh.
mcq.expl:
in + year / century; during + a period (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + length of time; until = up to a time; by = not later than; at that time.
in + năm / thế kỷ; during + một khoảng thời gian (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + độ dài thời gian; until = cho đến khi; by = không muộn hơn; at that time.
Điểm ngữ pháp: during + một khoảng thời gian.
mcq.key: ___ the next few years it quickly became the main trading centre in Britain.|During

mcq.question: ___ two hundred years after the Romans left, the city was almost forgotten.
mcq.full: For two hundred years after the Romans left, the city was almost forgotten.
mcq.vi: Suốt hai trăm năm sau khi người La Mã rời đi, thành phố gần như bị lãng quên.
mcq.expl:
in + year / century; during + a period (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + length of time; until = up to a time; by = not later than; at that time.
in + năm / thế kỷ; during + một khoảng thời gian (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + độ dài thời gian; until = cho đến khi; by = không muộn hơn; at that time.
Điểm ngữ pháp: for + độ dài thời gian.
mcq.key: ___ two hundred years after the Romans left, the city was almost forgotten.|For

mcq.question: The full importance of the city of London did not return ___ the eleventh century.
mcq.full: The full importance of the city of London did not return until the eleventh century.
mcq.vi: Tầm quan trọng của London mãi đến thế kỷ mười một mới trở lại.
mcq.expl:
in + year / century; during + a period (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + length of time; until = up to a time; by = not later than; at that time.
in + năm / thế kỷ; during + một khoảng thời gian (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + độ dài thời gian; until = cho đến khi; by = không muộn hơn; at that time.
Điểm ngữ pháp: not … until.
mcq.key: The full importance of the city of London did not return ___ the eleventh century.|until

mcq.question: ___ the end of that century, the government of England was based in Westminster.
mcq.full: By the end of that century, the government of England was based in Westminster.
mcq.vi: Đến cuối thế kỷ đó, chính phủ Anh đặt tại Westminster.
mcq.expl:
in + year / century; during + a period (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + length of time; until = up to a time; by = not later than; at that time.
in + năm / thế kỷ; during + một khoảng thời gian (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + độ dài thời gian; until = cho đến khi; by = không muộn hơn; at that time.
Điểm ngữ pháp: by / at the end of.
mcq.key: ___ the end of that century, the government of England was based in Westminster.|By

mcq.question: ___ the Middle Ages London continued to grow.
mcq.full: During the Middle Ages London continued to grow.
mcq.vi: Trong suốt thời Trung cổ, London tiếp tục phát triển.
mcq.expl:
in + year / century; during + a period (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + length of time; until = up to a time; by = not later than; at that time.
in + năm / thế kỷ; during + một khoảng thời gian (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + độ dài thời gian; until = cho đến khi; by = không muộn hơn; at that time.
Điểm ngữ pháp: during + giai đoạn.
mcq.key: ___ the Middle Ages London continued to grow.|During

mcq.question: ___ the time of Shakespeare, it had become a prosperous capital city with many fine buildings.
mcq.full: By the time of Shakespeare, it had become a prosperous capital city with many fine buildings.
mcq.vi: Đến thời Shakespeare, nó đã trở thành thủ đô thịnh vượng với nhiều công trình đẹp.
mcq.expl:
in + year / century; during + a period (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + length of time; until = up to a time; by = not later than; at that time.
in + năm / thế kỷ; during + một khoảng thời gian (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + độ dài thời gian; until = cho đến khi; by = không muộn hơn; at that time.
Điểm ngữ pháp: by + thời điểm + quá khứ hoàn thành.
mcq.key: ___ the time of Shakespeare, it had become a prosperous capital city with many fine buildings.|By

mcq.question: Most of these buildings were made of wood and ___ 1666 they were almost all destroyed by a fire.
mcq.full: Most of these buildings were made of wood and in 1666 they were almost all destroyed by a fire.
mcq.vi: Hầu hết các công trình làm bằng gỗ và vào năm 1666 chúng gần như bị lửa thiêu rụi.
mcq.expl:
in + year / century; during + a period (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + length of time; until = up to a time; by = not later than; at that time.
in + năm / thế kỷ; during + một khoảng thời gian (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + độ dài thời gian; until = cho đến khi; by = không muộn hơn; at that time.
Điểm ngữ pháp: in + năm.
mcq.key: Most of these buildings were made of wood and ___ 1666 they were almost all destroyed by a fire.|in

mcq.question: … destroyed by a fire which lasted ___ several days.
mcq.full: … destroyed by a fire which lasted for several days.
mcq.vi: … thiêu rụi bởi đám cháy kéo dài suốt vài ngày.
mcq.expl:
in + year / century; during + a period (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + length of time; until = up to a time; by = not later than; at that time.
in + năm / thế kỷ; during + một khoảng thời gian (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + độ dài thời gian; until = cho đến khi; by = không muộn hơn; at that time.
Điểm ngữ pháp: for + độ dài thời gian.
mcq.key: … destroyed by a fire which lasted ___ several days.|for

mcq.question: The Great Fire of London was a real tragedy for the people living there ___ that time.
mcq.full: The Great Fire of London was a real tragedy for the people living there at that time.
mcq.vi: Đại hỏa hoạn London là thảm kịch thật sự với người dân sống ở đó vào thời điểm ấy.
mcq.expl:
in + year / century; during + a period (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + length of time; until = up to a time; by = not later than; at that time.
in + năm / thế kỷ; during + một khoảng thời gian (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + độ dài thời gian; until = cho đến khi; by = không muộn hơn; at that time.
Điểm ngữ pháp: at that time.
mcq.key: The Great Fire of London was a real tragedy for the people living there ___ that time.|at

mcq.question: … many of the areas which are most attractive today were planned ___ the rebuilding which followed.
mcq.full: … many of the areas which are most attractive today were planned during the rebuilding which followed.
mcq.vi: … nhiều khu đẹp nhất ngày nay được quy hoạch trong đợt tái thiết sau đó.
mcq.expl:
in + year / century; during + a period (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + length of time; until = up to a time; by = not later than; at that time.
in + năm / thế kỷ; during + một khoảng thời gian (the next few years, the Middle Ages, the rebuilding); for + độ dài thời gian; until = cho đến khi; by = không muộn hơn; at that time.
Điểm ngữ pháp: during + danh từ.
mcq.key: … many of the areas which are most attractive today were planned ___ the rebuilding which followed.|during

mcq.question: I finish work at 6.30 am. Then I go home, have a shower and try to be in bed ___ half past eight.
mcq.full: I finish work at 6.30 am. Then I go home, have a shower and try to be in bed by half past eight.
mcq.vi: Tôi tan ca lúc 6 giờ 30 sáng. Rồi về nhà, tắm và cố lên giường trước tám giờ rưỡi.
mcq.expl:
at + clock time / the same time / night / the moment; by = not later than; until = up to; in the afternoon; while + clause; for + period; on time; during the day; no preposition before last / every.
at + giờ / the same time / night / the moment; by = không muộn hơn; until = cho đến khi; in the afternoon; while + mệnh đề; for + khoảng thời gian; on time; during the day; không dùng giới từ trước last / every.
Điểm ngữ pháp: by = không muộn hơn.
mcq.key: I finish work at 6.30 am. Then I go home, have a shower and try to be in bed ___ half past eight.|by

mcq.question: ___ the same time as I’m getting ready for bed, Joanne, my wife, and our daughter are getting up.
mcq.full: At the same time as I’m getting ready for bed, Joanne, my wife, and our daughter are getting up.
mcq.vi: Cùng lúc tôi chuẩn bị đi ngủ, vợ tôi là Joanne và con gái thức dậy.
mcq.expl:
at + clock time / the same time / night / the moment; by = not later than; until = up to; in the afternoon; while + clause; for + period; on time; during the day; no preposition before last / every.
at + giờ / the same time / night / the moment; by = không muộn hơn; until = cho đến khi; in the afternoon; while + mệnh đề; for + khoảng thời gian; on time; during the day; không dùng giới từ trước last / every.
Điểm ngữ pháp: at the same time.
mcq.key: ___ the same time as I’m getting ready for bed, Joanne, my wife, and our daughter are getting up.|At

mcq.question: Joanne drops Elaine at nursery school, which she started ___ last year.
mcq.full: Joanne drops Elaine at nursery school, which she started last year.
mcq.vi: Joanne đưa Elaine đến trường mẫu giáo, nơi bé bắt đầu học năm ngoái.
mcq.expl:
at + clock time / the same time / night / the moment; by = not later than; until = up to; in the afternoon; while + clause; for + period; on time; during the day; no preposition before last / every.
at + giờ / the same time / night / the moment; by = không muộn hơn; until = cho đến khi; in the afternoon; while + mệnh đề; for + khoảng thời gian; on time; during the day; không dùng giới từ trước last / every.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Không dùng giới từ trước last.
mcq.key: Joanne drops Elaine at nursery school, which she started ___ last year.|–

mcq.question: I usually sleep ___ about three o’clock in the afternoon.
mcq.full: I usually sleep until about three o’clock in the afternoon.
mcq.vi: Tôi thường ngủ đến khoảng ba giờ chiều.
mcq.expl:
at + clock time / the same time / night / the moment; by = not later than; until = up to; in the afternoon; while + clause; for + period; on time; during the day; no preposition before last / every.
at + giờ / the same time / night / the moment; by = không muộn hơn; until = cho đến khi; in the afternoon; while + mệnh đề; for + khoảng thời gian; on time; during the day; không dùng giới từ trước last / every.
Điểm ngữ pháp: until = cho đến khi.
mcq.key: I usually sleep ___ about three o’clock in the afternoon.|until

mcq.question: I usually sleep until about three o’clock ___ the afternoon.
mcq.full: I usually sleep until about three o’clock in the afternoon.
mcq.vi: Tôi thường ngủ đến khoảng ba giờ chiều.
mcq.expl:
at + clock time / the same time / night / the moment; by = not later than; until = up to; in the afternoon; while + clause; for + period; on time; during the day; no preposition before last / every.
at + giờ / the same time / night / the moment; by = không muộn hơn; until = cho đến khi; in the afternoon; while + mệnh đề; for + khoảng thời gian; on time; during the day; không dùng giới từ trước last / every.
Điểm ngữ pháp: in the afternoon.
mcq.key: I usually sleep until about three o’clock ___ the afternoon.|in

mcq.question: We come home and she plays or watches a cartoon ___ I prepare our meal.
mcq.full: We come home and she plays or watches a cartoon while I prepare our meal.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi về nhà và bé chơi hoặc xem phim hoạt hình trong khi tôi nấu ăn.
mcq.expl:
at + clock time / the same time / night / the moment; by = not later than; until = up to; in the afternoon; while + clause; for + period; on time; during the day; no preposition before last / every.
at + giờ / the same time / night / the moment; by = không muộn hơn; until = cho đến khi; in the afternoon; while + mệnh đề; for + khoảng thời gian; on time; during the day; không dùng giới từ trước last / every.
Điểm ngữ pháp: while + mệnh đề.
mcq.key: We come home and she plays or watches a cartoon ___ I prepare our meal.|while

mcq.question: If we’re lucky, we can relax ___ an hour before putting Elaine to bed.
mcq.full: If we’re lucky, we can relax for an hour before putting Elaine to bed.
mcq.vi: Nếu may, chúng tôi được thư giãn một tiếng trước khi cho Elaine đi ngủ.
mcq.expl:
at + clock time / the same time / night / the moment; by = not later than; until = up to; in the afternoon; while + clause; for + period; on time; during the day; no preposition before last / every.
at + giờ / the same time / night / the moment; by = không muộn hơn; until = cho đến khi; in the afternoon; while + mệnh đề; for + khoảng thời gian; on time; during the day; không dùng giới từ trước last / every.
Điểm ngữ pháp: for + khoảng thời gian.
mcq.key: If we’re lucky, we can relax ___ an hour before putting Elaine to bed.|for

mcq.question: I always allow plenty of time to get to the hospital because if I’m not there ___ time, another nurse will have to go on working.
mcq.full: I always allow plenty of time to get to the hospital because if I’m not there on time, another nurse will have to go on working.
mcq.vi: Tôi luôn dành nhiều thời gian đến bệnh viện vì nếu không có mặt đúng giờ, y tá khác sẽ phải làm tiếp.
mcq.expl:
at + clock time / the same time / night / the moment; by = not later than; until = up to; in the afternoon; while + clause; for + period; on time; during the day; no preposition before last / every.
at + giờ / the same time / night / the moment; by = không muộn hơn; until = cho đến khi; in the afternoon; while + mệnh đề; for + khoảng thời gian; on time; during the day; không dùng giới từ trước last / every.
Điểm ngữ pháp: on time = đúng giờ.
mcq.key: I always allow plenty of time to get to the hospital because if I’m not there ___ time, another nurse will have to go on working.|on

mcq.question: … another nurse will have to go on working ___ I arrive.
mcq.full: … another nurse will have to go on working until I arrive.
mcq.vi: … y tá khác sẽ phải làm tiếp cho đến khi tôi tới.
mcq.expl:
at + clock time / the same time / night / the moment; by = not later than; until = up to; in the afternoon; while + clause; for + period; on time; during the day; no preposition before last / every.
at + giờ / the same time / night / the moment; by = không muộn hơn; until = cho đến khi; in the afternoon; while + mệnh đề; for + khoảng thời gian; on time; during the day; không dùng giới từ trước last / every.
Điểm ngữ pháp: until + mệnh đề.
mcq.key: … another nurse will have to go on working ___ I arrive.|until

mcq.question: I’m often very tired ___ the time I finish, but I don’t really mind.
mcq.full: I’m often very tired by the time I finish, but I don’t really mind.
mcq.vi: Tôi thường rất mệt lúc tan ca, nhưng cũng không sao.
mcq.expl:
at + clock time / the same time / night / the moment; by = not later than; until = up to; in the afternoon; while + clause; for + period; on time; during the day; no preposition before last / every.
at + giờ / the same time / night / the moment; by = không muộn hơn; until = cho đến khi; in the afternoon; while + mệnh đề; for + khoảng thời gian; on time; during the day; không dùng giới từ trước last / every.
Điểm ngữ pháp: by the time.
mcq.key: I’m often very tired ___ the time I finish, but I don’t really mind.|by

mcq.question: There’s a special atmosphere in the hospital ___ night.
mcq.full: There’s a special atmosphere in the hospital at night.
mcq.vi: Bệnh viện có bầu không khí đặc biệt vào ban đêm.
mcq.expl:
at + clock time / the same time / night / the moment; by = not later than; until = up to; in the afternoon; while + clause; for + period; on time; during the day; no preposition before last / every.
at + giờ / the same time / night / the moment; by = không muộn hơn; until = cho đến khi; in the afternoon; while + mệnh đề; for + khoảng thời gian; on time; during the day; không dùng giới từ trước last / every.
Điểm ngữ pháp: at night.
mcq.key: There’s a special atmosphere in the hospital ___ night.|at

mcq.question: Of course, I have a free day ___ every week.
mcq.full: Of course, I have a free day every week.
mcq.vi: Tất nhiên tôi có một ngày nghỉ mỗi tuần.
mcq.expl:
at + clock time / the same time / night / the moment; by = not later than; until = up to; in the afternoon; while + clause; for + period; on time; during the day; no preposition before last / every.
at + giờ / the same time / night / the moment; by = không muộn hơn; until = cho đến khi; in the afternoon; while + mệnh đề; for + khoảng thời gian; on time; during the day; không dùng giới từ trước last / every.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Không dùng giới từ trước every.
mcq.key: Of course, I have a free day ___ every week.|–

mcq.question: I may want to work ___ the day when Elaine goes to a different school.
mcq.full: I may want to work during the day when Elaine goes to a different school.
mcq.vi: Tôi có thể muốn làm ban ngày khi Elaine chuyển trường.
mcq.expl:
at + clock time / the same time / night / the moment; by = not later than; until = up to; in the afternoon; while + clause; for + period; on time; during the day; no preposition before last / every.
at + giờ / the same time / night / the moment; by = không muộn hơn; until = cho đến khi; in the afternoon; while + mệnh đề; for + khoảng thời gian; on time; during the day; không dùng giới từ trước last / every.
Điểm ngữ pháp: during the day.
mcq.key: I may want to work ___ the day when Elaine goes to a different school.|during

mcq.question: Perhaps I’ll be ready for a change ___ then.
mcq.full: Perhaps I’ll be ready for a change by then.
mcq.vi: Có lẽ đến lúc đó tôi sẽ sẵn sàng thay đổi.
mcq.expl:
at + clock time / the same time / night / the moment; by = not later than; until = up to; in the afternoon; while + clause; for + period; on time; during the day; no preposition before last / every.
at + giờ / the same time / night / the moment; by = không muộn hơn; until = cho đến khi; in the afternoon; while + mệnh đề; for + khoảng thời gian; on time; during the day; không dùng giới từ trước last / every.
Điểm ngữ pháp: by then.
mcq.key: Perhaps I’ll be ready for a change ___ then.|by

mcq.question: Here’s a photo taken in my classroom at primary school. Can you recognise me ___ it?
mcq.full: Here’s a photo taken in my classroom at primary school. Can you recognise me in it?
mcq.vi: Đây là ảnh chụp trong lớp hồi tiểu học. Bạn nhận ra tớ trong ảnh không?
mcq.expl:
in a photo, at the back, in the corner, in a letter, on a page, at a disco, return to a country, on a bus, arrive at a station.
in a photo, at the back, in the corner, in a letter, on a page, at a disco, return to + nước, on a bus, arrive at + nhà ga.
Điểm ngữ pháp: in a photo.
mcq.key: Here’s a photo taken in my classroom at primary school. Can you recognise me ___ it?|in

mcq.question: No, I don’t think so. Unless that’s you right ___ the back.
mcq.full: No, I don’t think so. Unless that’s you right at the back.
mcq.vi: Không, chắc không. Trừ khi bạn là người ở phía cuối lớp.

as = với vai trò; in the shade; on a diet; by credit card; by + tác nhân (bị động); at + tốc độ; in capital letters; like = giống như.
Điểm ngữ pháp: like = giống như.
mcq.key: What colour is Danni’s new bag? (the last one) – It’s navy blue, ___.|like the last one

mcq.question: What are you doing in the summer holidays? (motorcycle messenger) – I’ve got a job ___.
mcq.full: What are you doing in the summer holidays? (motorcycle messenger) – I’ve got a job as a motorcycle messenger.
mcq.vi: Nghỉ hè bạn làm gì? – Tôi có việc làm người giao hàng bằng xe máy.
